notes.title: The Silent Kingdom release date
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

I'm very happy to announce that The Silent Kingdom will release as Early Access on [b]2025, February 18[/b].

This Early Access version will contain both the prologue and Chapter 1, and will be updated with two more chapters as soon as possible.

If you were expectant to know the continuation of the story, your journey will continue very soon!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41620871/bde225c533b9df047c82b4790a9f301de9bd371c.png[/img]

notes.title: Small update based on feedback
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Since the 1.0 demo was released, I've been taking note of feedback. I'm happy that the demo has been so well received, and I've been working quickly on the changes that many players were asking for. I want it to be as good as possible for Next Fest!

Over the course of this week, the demo has received a couple of updates:

[list]
[*]The rate of enemy encounters in the forest has been decreased.
[*]The tutorial on the double attack mechanics of the princess is more explicit and clearer now.
[*]Characters now show a new pose when blocking normal attacks. The sound is also more noticeable, making it easier to tell when you've successfully blocked.
[*]The battle start effect has been changed to a more eye-catching broken glass effect.
[*]Guards give twice as much experience as before.
[*]Added a plugin to prevent screen freezing with >60Hz monitors.
[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41620871/224e1684d01000c99b1f718e650f329ccce58c0f.gif[/img]

Thank you all for testing the demo and for your feedback! Your comments give me a lot of encouragement to keep working, and also help me to improve the game.
